messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager (P1) triggered - kv-cache prefix cardinality surge affecting continuous-batching paths. Root cause suspected: replay/wavefront of unique prefixes from MQA traffic. Paging oncall @alice. Link: https://grafana.redwood/board/kv-cache?from=3167893000&to=3167894600

alice: taking this - oncall here. starting triage. pinging ben & carmen for runtime + srep.

alice: quick summary from initial scrub: sudden jump in unique KV keys at 3167894200, cont-batch queue depth x4, evictions up 5x, tail token latency >2s for some shards. Affects generation route: /v1/generate (models: qwen-mqa-1.2, mistral-2-small, llama-3b variants seen). Customers seeing 5xx: acme-inc (prod), small batch of webhooks.

ben: I see same in traces. Big cardinality spike coming from many different prefix hashes, looks like client replay creating near-unique prefixes. Metric dump snippet: 

```
unique_prefx_per_min: 3.2M -> 12.4M
contbatch_queue_len: 120 -> 480
kv_evictions/s: 45 -> 230
tail_p50/p95/p99: 45ms/410ms/2100ms
hot_shard: shard-12, shard-19
model_breakdown: qwen-mqa-1.2: 68% of increased keys
```

carmen: logs (filtered) - showing repeated unusual prefix tokens from a few IPs: 

```
2026-03-15T10:45:12Z shard-12 INFO prefix=usr:session:ab12c3… seq=1 model=qwen-mqa-1.2
2026-03-15T10:45:12Z shard-12 INFO prefix=usr:session:ab12c4… seq=1 model=qwen-mqa-1.2
2026-03-15T10:45:12Z shard-12 INFO prefix=usr:session:ab12c5… seq=1 model=qwen-mqa-1.2
... repeated patterns from 13.82.44.21 and 13.82.44.22
```

carmen: putting alive grep for user-agents shows a bot-like client hitting generate with varied prompt ids. likely a replay test or misconfigured fanout.

dora: support - we have two active customer tickets: acme-inc reported ~20% request failures in last 10m, chatterprod reported delays. Need a short customer-facing note: "We are investigating increased latency and failures for generation routes; mitigation in progress."

alice: proposed live mitigations (ordered):
1) Immediately throttle cont-batching for MQA-enabled models (apply per-model batch cap).
2) Enable prefix-dedupe heuristic (drop near-duplicate prefix keys within 30s window).
3) Temporarily reduce contbatch max_batch_tokens and max_batch_items for qwen-mqa-1.2 and mistral-2-small.
4) If above insufficient, apply shard-level write-rate limiter to prevent kv-thrashing.
5) Notify customers (dora to send updates).

ben: prepared hotfix commands - canary to shard-12 then shard-19. Snippets below: 

```
# throttle contbatch for MQA models
curl -X POST https://config.redwood/v1/runtime/update -d '{"model":"qwen-mqa-1.2","contbatch_max_items":8,"contbatch_max_tokens":1024}'

# enable quick dedupe heuristic
curl -X POST https://config.redwood/v1/runtime/update -d '{"kv_prefix_dedupe_window_s":30,"kv_prefix_dedupe_enabled":true}'
```

ben: will apply canary to shard-12 now. tagging deploy-bot.

deploy-bot: canary update queued for shard-12 with change-id=c-3167894321-1. Canary deploy start: 3167894360. Rolling window 2m, watch metrics.

carmen: canary applied to shard-12. early metrics: evictions down 40%, contbatch queue length down 30%, tail_p99 dropped ~900ms -> 300ms.

ben: promoting to shard-19 and then global if stable. Applying reduced batch sizes for qwen-mqa-1.2 + mistral.

deploy-bot: shard-19 canary start: 3167894435. change-id=c-3167894321-2.

alice: monitoring. initial customer impact mitigation looks positive. still seeing small residual increased latency on shard-3 (different tenanted traffic), but no large customer outages.

dora: crafting customer update email: short note + ETA for next update 30m. will send once we confirm global rollback risk low.

ben: after global rollout: global evictions down 65% vs spike. contbatch backlog returned to baseline. qwen-specific unique prefix rate fell ~78% (likely clients throttled or dedupe absorbing).

incident-bot: Incident status -> mitigation applied. Pager cleared for oncall.

alice: wrapping up handoff: creating follow-up playbook and postmortem. Action items:
- SRE: implement adaptive prefix dedupe default for high-cardinality models (carmen)
- Runtime: add per-client prefix rate limits and alert when unique prefix rate per client > X/min (ben)
- Support: customer comms + CS outreach for acme-inc (dora)
- Product: consider MQA contbatch guard rails and doc for integration partners (alice)

dora: customer note sent: "Mitigation in place; root cause under investigation; follow-up within 24h." acme confirmed reduced errors.

alice: moving to monitoring / postmortem. thanks everyone. leaving notes in #incidents and opening PM.

carmen: small follow-up: capture full key sample dump and upload to secure S3 for forensics (will redact PII).

ben: will run a short eval to see whether model-side tokenization differences caused explosion in prefix space for qwen-mqa variants.

alice: closing thread for live handoff, assigning postmortem owner: alice -> will post timeline and RCA in 24-48h."
